records.description: InstaStack is an all-in-one Instagram toolkit built for desktop users. Instagram on PC and Mac still lacks essential features, so InstaStack brings them together in a single Chrome extension. Track unfollowers, auto follow, upload stories from desktop, download reels, videos, and images, and view stories anonymously with ghost mode. Everything runs directly inside your browser — no mobile apps, no extra software, just faster and more productive Instagram on desktop.

records.name: Candle (YC F24)
records.tagline: One shared moment a day
records.description: Candle is a daily game that helps close friends and couples strengthen their connection through one shared, random challenge a day. Each day unlocks a new, interactive moment, a thoughtful question, unique debate, drawing or photo challenge, mini game, or simple local date idea. Candle creates small “connection nudges” that gently spark conversation, play, in person connection, and emotional closeness.
